C0900.title: TPMS Sensor 1 Battery
C0900.description: TPMS Sensor 1 Battery: the control module has detected this fault condition.

causes.label: TPMS sensor battery depleted (end of life)

C0901.title: TPMS Sensor 1 Position Performance
C0901.description: The tire pressure monitoring receiver cannot reliably localize sensor 1 to a wheel position. Pressure values may be assigned to the wrong wheel until relearn is completed.

C0902.title: TPMS Sensor 2 Battery
C0902.description: TPMS Sensor 2 Battery: the control module has detected this fault condition.

causes.label: TPMS sensor battery depleted (end of life)

C0903.title: TPMS Sensor 2 Position Performance
C0903.description: The tire pressure monitoring receiver cannot reliably localize sensor 2 to a wheel position. Pressure values may be assigned to the wrong wheel until relearn is completed.

C0905.title: TPMS Sensor 3 Battery Low
C0905.description: The TPMS receiver reports that the internal battery of sensor 3 is at end of life. The sensor must be replaced as the battery is sealed inside the housing.

C0907.title: TPMS Sensor 4 Battery Low
C0907.description: The TPMS receiver reports that the internal battery of sensor 4 is at end of life. The sensor must be replaced as the battery is sealed inside the housing.

C0910.title: TPMS Receiver Circuit Malfunction
C0910.description: The body or chassis module has detected a fault in the TPMS RF receiver — for example open antenna or internal failure. No tire pressure data can be received.

C0912.title: TPMS Initiator Front Circuit Malfunction
C0912.description: The TPMS module has detected an electrical fault in the front low-frequency initiator (used to wake and locate sensors). Position learning of the front sensors fails.

C0915.title: Active Roll Stabilisation Front Actuator Circuit
C0915.description: The front active anti-roll bar actuator reports an electrical fault.

C0916.title: Active Roll Stabilisation Rear Actuator Circuit
C0916.description: The rear active anti-roll bar actuator reports an electrical fault.

C0920.title: Suspension Control Module Internal Fault
C0920.description: The suspension control module fails its internal self-test. Adaptive damping or air suspension is disabled.

C0950.title: Tire Pressure Monitoring Sensor Front Left
C0950.description: The TPMS sensor at the front left wheel does not transmit a valid signal. Indirect TPMS variants raise this when the wheel-speed-based estimation fails for that wheel.

C0951.title: Tire Pressure Monitoring Sensor Front Right
C0951.description: The TPMS sensor at the front right wheel does not transmit a valid signal.

C0952.title: Tire Pressure Monitoring Sensor Rear Left
C0952.description: The TPMS sensor at the rear left wheel does not transmit a valid signal.

C0953.title: Tire Pressure Monitoring Sensor Rear Right
C0953.description: The TPMS sensor at the rear right wheel does not transmit a valid signal.

C0960.title: Tire Pressure Monitoring Module Internal Fault
C0960.description: The tire pressure monitoring module fails its internal self-test.
